description: Elections Commission - Amended Notice for Local Authorities in Kandy District (Order under Section 38(3) of the L. A. E. O.)
categorisation: This gazette content is a notification about the postponement of local authority elections, specifically announcing a new election date (25th April 2023) for various local authorities in the Kandy Administrative District. It directly relates to electoral processes under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, making it clearly an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
